doctrine: ads8: five spec ads (grok, zai, moonshot, claude, claudecode), ads7 grammar: absurd open, plain model, visual quirk never narrated, mouths closed, centre-square composition, guard verbatim
guard: Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, documentary realism, no beauty smoothing, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing with small human hesitations. No readable on-screen text anywhere in frame, no logos, no brand marks. Keep hands either fully out of frame or large, simple and clearly articulated. NO narration, NO voiceover, NO captions, NO avatar or presenter, no music, natural ambient sound only. One single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, subject centered, raw b-roll for an edit. Composed for a centered square crop: every story object stays inside the middle third of the frame and never approaches the left or right edge.

grok.positioning: xAI's general assistant with real-time search and native tool use, on web and mobile, where news breaks first (verified: x.ai, docs.x.ai, 2026-08-29 pairwise pass)
grok.quirk: a pigeon on the bench freezes mid-head-bob when everything around it freezes, one foot still lifted
grok.narration: The whole street changes its mind three times before your coffee cools. Grok is the assistant that watches the world in real time, from the place where news breaks first. Ask it while it's still happening.
grok.closer: Grok, real-time answers with the sources still warm. Ask it while it's happening. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.

scenes.a: {character} sits facing camera on the night shelter bench. At 0.2 seconds, newspapers shoot sideways off the newsstand into a waist-high carousel in the air before him. At 0.55 seconds they reverse; at 0.9 seconds they unfold into a rippling staircase beside him. The displays flip with each reversal. End seated, face clear above the moving pages. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: The displays snap black and stay black. Every airborne newspaper drops straight down at once and lands flat around the bench, and each stays exactly where it lands. {character} immediately stands facing camera, as though this impossible interruption is his bus arriving. The bench and newsstand stay fixed. End upright, frontal, face clear, papers lying still around his feet. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: {character} slowly sits back on the same bench, facing camera, for one late, quiet beat. Every newspaper stays exactly where it lies on the pavement and the bench. Every black display stays black. End seated, hands on knees, face clear. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.d: Only after he settles, {character} takes his phone from his coat and raises its illuminated assistant interface beside his shoulder, below his unobstructed face. A response visibly builds on screen. He holds it toward camera, frontal and still. The bench, newsstand and every fallen sheet stay in place; every black display stays black. End with phone steady and face sharp. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.

props: The same fixed night bus shelter and bench
Newspapers that have landed stay where they lie
